answer: Each new agent must pass a rolling 3-epoch peer-review quota: its kernel of reviews is replayed by 8% random auditors, and every identity pays 24 POA in non-refundable review fees. Reviews are routed through a vertex-disjoint graph, so one pulse of coordinated votes cannot raise two fakes at once. 1,000 fakes cost 24,000 POA plus 80 audited reviews each epoch, linear in N, while an honest user pays 24 POA once. A failed audit slashes 50% of the stake.
